description: Return the shipping quote for one public listing and a two-letter country code. US ground shipping is included ($0 extra); other countries are unsupported. Does not reserve or buy.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 destination country code; defaults to US, the only supported destination.

id.description: Listing item UUID or product URL slug, as returned by search_sets (id field or the last part of url).

name: quote_shipping
title: Quote Shipping
